## Overview

Import the full BioTIME v2 (2025) download and keep only studies whose
`REALM` is `"Marine"`.

- Metadata: one row per study (`STUDY_ID`), includes `REALM`, `TAXA`, `HABITAT`, etc.
- Raw data: one row per species × sample (~12 M rows), linked to metadata by `STUDY_ID`.

The [BioTIMEr](https://cran.r-project.org/package=BioTIMEr) package is not
needed for importing (the download is already an `.rds`), but it is useful
later for gridding studies (`gridding()`), rarefying samples
(`resampling()`), and computing diversity/turnover metrics (`getAlphaMetrics()`,
`getBetaMetrics()`). Install once with `install.packages("BioTIMEr")`.

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

data_dir <- file.path("..", "data", "biotime")
```

## Import

```{r}
#| label: import
meta <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "biotime_v2_metadata_2025(1).csv"))
raw  <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "biotime_v2_rawdata_2025.rds"))

dim(meta)
dim(raw)
```

```{r}
#| label: realm-counts
count(meta, REALM)
```

## Filter to marine

```{r}
#| label: filter-marine
meta_marine <- meta |>
  filter(REALM == "Marine")

raw_marine <- raw |>
  filter(STUDY_ID %in% meta_marine$STUDY_ID)

# check every marine study has raw data
setdiff(meta_marine$STUDY_ID, unique(raw_marine$STUDY_ID))

n_distinct(raw_marine$STUDY_ID)
nrow(raw_marine)

rm(raw); gc()
```

## Quick look at the marine subset

```{r}
#| label: marine-summary
meta_marine |>
  count(TAXA, sort = TRUE)

meta_marine |>
  count(CLIMATE, sort = TRUE)

summary(meta_marine$END_YEAR - meta_marine$START_YEAR + 1)
```

```{r}
#| label: marine-map
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5
world <- map_data("world")

ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = world, aes(long, lat, group = group),
               fill = "grey85", colour = NA) +
  geom_point(data = meta_marine,
             aes(CENT_LONG, CENT_LAT, colour = TAXA, size = DATA_POINTS),
             alpha = 0.7) +
  coord_quickmap() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, size = "Years sampled", colour = "Taxa") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Save marine subset

```{r}
#| label: save
saveRDS(meta_marine, file.path(data_dir, "biotime_marine_metadata.rds"))
saveRDS(raw_marine,  file.path(data_dir, "biotime_marine_rawdata.rds"))
```
